searchText: Hey, has someone already read this? https://hut8mining.com/hut-8-expands-mining-capacity-with-30-million-usd-purchase-of-nvidia-cmps I am confused. Why did they do this if soon much of the GPU mining hardware will be useless and sold? 🤔 Not everyone follows along with Ethereum development, and past wildly inaccurate time estimates have caused people to no longer trust Ethereum developer time estimates. <dankrad> It's OK if people want to speculate on us not delivering. But it's on them if they lose their money there will inevitably be folks complaining (post-merge) that something isn’t right with their mining equipment only realize the merge had already occurred. I seems to me that they are aiming to expand into parallelized computation (which may be a good market as well), doesn't hurt to mine while it's still profitable.
